note: Expert code is not in this repository. It lives in the agent above in the Extella market; sha = first 12 hex of sha256 of the code. Versions with in_market=false were used by earlier runs only.

experts.name: drone_plan
experts.description: Feel like a drone courier, the benchmark expert: checks an intent written in the flight language against the wind forecast and its worst edge (mode=check), or flies the whole two-hour shift by that intent in the real world (mode=run). This is the exact version that played the 30 recorded shifts of stage 4 on extella.dev/drone.

experts.name: drone_shift
experts.description: Feel like a drone courier, the whole game in one expert: mode=brief gives the world of this city and day as the player sees it plus the flight language reference, mode=check checks an intent and names the one line that would help most, mode=run flies the shift and returns the score and the handler refusals, mode=replay recomputes the score from a shift log for the leaderboard (strictly: a rejected decision raises).
